lead_story: The Fed's upcoming rate decision is the biggest macro driver right now, with markets awaiting a potential pause in rate hikes. Easing Middle East tensions have reduced inflation risk and supported stock markets. The outcome of the Fed's decision will likely influence the direction of the dollar and other assets.
